annotations.title: Compare two versions of an EU article

description: WHAT CHANGED in an EU article between two dates — the delta, not both full texts. The EU twin of compare_article. Use it to check whether a provision a judgment relied on has since been rewritten, or what a reform actually altered. Says plainly when NOTHING changed, which is the answer to 'has this been amended since', and reports honestly when no consolidated version covers one of the dates rather than comparing against a text that did not exist.
name: compare_eu_article
